title: R60: isolated bf16 vs FP8 head+CE cost (discounted-60% route correction)
conclusions: Isolated b=16 head+CE: bf16 fused path 40.65 ms (chunk 8192) / 45.31 (chunk 2048) vs ideal 3-GEMM 23.29 ms and FP8 v3 14.95 ms.

The bf16 head profile shows where the gap is: the three GEMMs take 28.5 ms (the dX-side 128x256 GEMM alone is 15.0 ms vs 7.77 ideal), and the bf16 softmax + CE kernels add ~9.1 ms (softmax 6.58 + ce_fwd 2.56 + misc).

Discounted-MFU consequence: a bf16 FLOP counts 1, fp8 0.5, so the fp8 head is only a win if it is >=2x faster than the (optimized) bf16 head. Current all-bf16 step is 86.32 ms with 38.41% discounted MFU, already above the 35.59% of the fp8-head mix - the route to 60% is to optimize the bf16 head and the non-head blocks, then use b=24/32.
FP8 v3 at b=32 silently falls back to bf16 (int32 TP*V limit, already warned in v0.2.12).
